user.title: Configure Adaptive Growth Light
user.description: Set up intelligent supplemental lighting for your plants based on natural sunlight and target photoperiod.

data_description.name: Leave blank to automatically name after the selected entity (e.g. 'Ficus Adaptive Light').
data_description.morning_split: Percentage of supplementary lighting hours allocated to morning before sunrise (remainder scheduled after sunset) when 'Both' mode is selected.
data_description.earliest_start: Leave empty for no morning limit. When set, lighting before this time is prevented and moved to the evening.
data_description.latest_end: Leave empty for no evening limit. When set, lighting after this time is prevented.

split.title: Morning / Evening Split Ratio
split.description: Configure how supplemental lighting hours are divided between morning (before sunrise) and evening (after sunset).
